question: Chapchar Kut festival is predominantly celebrated in _________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Mizoram.**__

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

__
 
• **Chapchar Kut** is a traditional festival celebrated in Mizoram.
 
• It is a time when the **Mizo community **comes together to celebrate.
 
• **Chapchar Kut is a spring festival celebrated in March after completion of the Jhum cultivation**.
 
• ​This festival is a public holiday in the state.
 
• Traditional **bamboo dance **- **Cheraw **and other dances were performed at the main event, attracting thousands of people.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Mizoram:
 
 
• State Animal - **Sumatran serow**
 
• State Bird - Mrs. **Hume's pheasant**
 
 
 
• National Parks
 
 
• **Murlen National Park **
 
• **Blue Mountain National Park **
